verses.text: Paul, an apostle (sent one) of Jesus Christ by the will of God. To the saints (holy people) who are at Ephesus, and to the faithful in Christ Jesus:
Grace be to you, and peace, from God our Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ.
Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ. God has blessed us with all spiritual blessings in heavenly places in Christ.
God has chosen us in Christ before the foundation of the world. We should be holy and without blame before Him in love.
God predestinated (chose ahead of time) us to the adoption (being made God's children) by Jesus Christ to Himself. This was according to the good pleasure of His will.
This is to the praise of the glory of His grace. By His grace God has made us accepted in the Beloved (His dear Son).
In Christ we have redemption (being bought back and set free) through His blood. We have the forgiveness of sins, according to the riches of His grace.
God has abounded (poured out richly) this grace toward us in all wisdom and prudence (understanding).
God has made known to us the mystery (secret) of His will. This was according to His good pleasure, which He has purposed (planned) in Himself.

It is for the dispensation (work) of the fulness of times. Then God will gather together in one all things in Christ. This means things which are in heaven, and things which are on earth, even in Christ.
In Christ also we have obtained an inheritance. We were predestinated (chosen ahead of time) according to the purpose of God. God works all things after the counsel (plan) of His own will.
This is so that we should be to the praise of His glory. We are the ones who first trusted in Christ.

You also trusted in Christ after you heard the word of truth. That word is the gospel (good news) of your salvation. After you believed in Christ, you were sealed (marked as God's own) with that Holy Spirit of promise.

The Holy Spirit is the earnest (first payment) of our inheritance. This lasts until the redemption (being bought back and set free) of the purchased possession (those God bought as His own). It is to the praise of His glory.
So I also heard of your faith in the Lord Jesus. I heard of your love to all the saints (holy people).
Since then I do not cease (stop) to give thanks for you. I make mention of you in my prayers.
I pray to the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory. May God give you the spirit of wisdom and revelation (showing) in the knowledge of Him.

I pray that the eyes of your understanding will be enlightened (filled with light). Then you may know what is the hope of His calling. And you may know the riches of the glory of His inheritance in the saints (holy people).
And you may know the exceeding greatness of His power toward us who believe. It is according to the working of His mighty power.
God worked this power in Christ when He raised Christ from the dead. God set Christ at His own right hand in the heavenly places.
Christ is far above all principality (rulers), and power, and might, and dominion (lordship). Christ is above every name that is named. This is not only in this world, but also in the world to come.
And God has put all things under Christ's feet. God gave Christ to be the head over all things to the church.
The church is Christ's body. The church is the fulness of Christ, who fills all in all.

verses.text: And God has quickened (made alive) you, who were dead in trespasses (wrongs) and sins.

In time past you walked in them, according to the course of this world. You walked according to the prince of the power of the air (the devil). The devil is the spirit that now works in the children of disobedience (people who disobey God).

Among them we all also had our conversation (way of life) in times past. We lived in the lusts (wrong desires) of our flesh (sinful self). We fulfilled the desires of the flesh (sinful self) and of the mind. By nature we were the children of wrath (God's anger), even as others.
But God is rich in mercy. God loved us with His great love.
Even when we were dead in sins, God has quickened (made alive) us together with Christ. By grace you are saved.
And God has raised us up together. God has made us sit together in heavenly places in Christ Jesus.
God did this to show the exceeding riches of His grace in the ages to come. God shows it in His kindness toward us through Christ Jesus.
For by grace you are saved through faith. And that is not of yourselves. It is the gift of God.
It is not of works (the good things we do), so that no one should boast (brag).
For we are God's workmanship (what God has made), created in Christ Jesus to do good works. God before ordained (planned ahead) these good works, that we should walk in them.

So remember that in time past you were Gentiles (people who are not Jews) in the flesh (by birth). You were called Uncircumcision by those who are called the Circumcision. Their circumcision is in the flesh (body), made by hands.

At that time you were without Christ. You were aliens (outsiders) from the commonwealth (nation) of Israel. You were strangers from the covenants (agreements) of promise. You had no hope, and were without God in the world.
But now you are in Christ Jesus. You who were sometimes (once) far off are made near by the blood of Christ.
For Christ is our peace. Christ has made both one. Christ has broken down the middle wall of partition (dividing wall) between us.

In His flesh (body) Christ abolished (did away with) the enmity (hate). The enmity (hate) was the law of commandments contained in ordinances (rules). Christ did this to make in Himself one new man from the 2. So Christ made peace.
And Christ did this to reconcile (bring back to God) both to God in one body by the cross. By the cross Christ slew (killed) the enmity (hate).
And Christ came and preached peace to you who were far off. Christ preached peace to those who were near.
For through Christ we both have access (a way to come) by one Spirit to the Father.
Now therefore you are no more strangers and foreigners. You are fellowcitizens with the saints (holy people), and of the household (family) of God.
You are built upon the foundation of the apostles (sent ones) and prophets. Jesus Christ Himself is the chief corner stone (the most important stone).
In Christ all the building is fitly framed (joined) together. It grows to a holy temple in the Lord.
In Christ you also are builded (built) together for a habitation (home) of God through the Spirit.

verses.text: For this cause I Paul am the prisoner of Jesus Christ for you Gentiles (people who are not Jews).
If you have heard of the dispensation (work) of God's grace which is given me for you,
By revelation (showing) God made known to me the mystery (secret). I wrote about it before in few words.
When you read this, you may understand my knowledge in the mystery (secret) of Christ.
In other ages this mystery (secret) was not made known to the sons of men (people). But now it is revealed (shown) to His holy apostles (sent ones) and prophets by the Spirit.

The mystery (secret) is this: The Gentiles (people who are not Jews) should be fellowheirs (sharing heirs), and of the same body. They should be partakers (sharers) of His promise in Christ by the gospel (good news).
I was made a minister (servant) of this gospel (good news). It was by the gift of the grace of God. That grace was given to me by the effectual (powerful) working of His power.

I am less than the least of all saints (holy people). Yet this grace is given to me. God gave it so that I should preach among the Gentiles (people who are not Jews) the unsearchable (too great to measure) riches of Christ.
I should also make all people see the fellowship (sharing) of the mystery (secret). From the beginning of the world it has been hid in God. God created all things by Jesus Christ.
God wants the principalities (rulers) and powers in heavenly places to know the manifold (many-sided) wisdom of God. They will know it now by the church.
This is according to the eternal purpose which God purposed (planned) in Christ Jesus our Lord.
In Christ we have boldness and access (a way to come) with confidence by the faith of Christ.
So I desire that you do not faint (lose heart) at my tribulations (troubles) for you. They are your glory.
For this cause I bow my knees to the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
The whole family in heaven and earth is named after the Father.
I pray that the Father would grant you this, according to the riches of His glory. I pray you would be strengthened with might by His Spirit in the inner man (your inner self).
I pray that Christ may dwell (live) in your hearts by faith. And I pray that you, being rooted and grounded (built firmly) in love,
May be able to comprehend (understand) with all saints (holy people) the breadth, and length, and depth, and height.
And I pray you may know the love of Christ, which passes (goes beyond) knowledge. Then you might be filled with all the fulness of God.
Now God is able to do exceeding abundantly above all that we ask or think. God does it according to the power that works in us.
To God be glory in the church by Christ Jesus throughout all ages, world without end. Amen.

verses.text: I therefore, the prisoner of the Lord, beseech (beg) you. Walk worthy of the vocation (calling) with which you are called.
Walk with all lowliness (humbleness) and meekness (gentleness), with longsuffering (patience). Forbear (put up with) one another in love.
Endeavour (work hard) to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.
There is one body, and one Spirit. You are called in one hope of your calling.
There is one Lord, one faith, one baptism,
There is one God and Father of all. He is above all, and through all, and in you all.
But grace is given to every one of us. It is given by the measure of the gift of Christ.
Therefore God says: When He ascended (went up) on high, He led captivity captive (led away the captives). He gave gifts to men.
Christ ascended (went up). What does that mean? It means that He also descended (came down) first into the lower parts of the earth.
Christ, who descended (came down), is the same one who ascended (went up) far above all heavens. Christ did this so that He might fill all things.
And Christ gave some to be apostles (sent ones), and some prophets. Christ gave some to be evangelists (those who tell the good news), and some pastors and teachers.
This is for the perfecting (making complete) of the saints (holy people). It is for the work of the ministry (serving). It is for the edifying (building up) of the body of Christ,

Till we all come in the unity of the faith. Till we come in the knowledge of the Son of God. We will come to a perfect (full-grown) man. We will reach the measure of the stature (full size) of the fulness of Christ.

Then we will be no more children, tossed to and fro. We will not be carried about with every wind of doctrine (teaching). We will not be fooled by the sleight (trickery) of people, and cunning craftiness. By these they lie in wait to deceive (fool).
But speaking the truth in love, we may grow up into Christ in all things. Christ is the head.

From Christ the whole body is fitly joined together and compacted (held together). It is held by that which every joint supplies. Every part works effectually (powerfully) in its measure. So the body makes increase (growth), to the edifying (building up) of itself in love.
This I say therefore, and testify in the Lord. From now on, do not walk as other Gentiles (people who are not Jews) walk, in the vanity (emptiness) of their mind.
Their understanding is darkened. They are alienated (cut off) from the life of God through the ignorance that is in them. This is because of the blindness of their heart.
Being past feeling, they have given themselves over to lasciviousness (shameless sexual desire). They work all uncleanness (impure living) with greediness.
But you have not so learned Christ,
If indeed you have heard Christ, and have been taught by Him. You were taught as the truth is in Jesus.
Put off the old man (old self) of your former conversation (way of life). The old man (old self) is corrupt (rotten) according to the deceitful lusts (wrong desires).
And be renewed (made new) in the spirit of your mind.
And put on the new man (new self). The new man (new self) after God is created in righteousness (being right with God) and true holiness.
Therefore putting away lying, let everyone speak truth with their neighbour. For we are members one of another.
Be angry, and do not sin. Do not let the sun go down on your wrath (anger).
Neither give place (room) to the devil.
Let the one who stole steal no more. Rather let them labour (work hard), working with their hands the thing which is good. Then they may have something to give to the one who needs.
Let no corrupt (rotten) communication (talk) proceed out of your mouth. Speak only what is good to the use of edifying (building up). Then it may minister (give) grace to the hearers.
And do not grieve (make sad) the Holy Spirit of God. By the Spirit you are sealed (marked as God's own) to the day of redemption (being bought back and set free).
Let all bitterness, wrath (rage), anger, clamour (shouting), and evil speaking be put away from you. Put away all malice (hate) too.
And be kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another. Forgive even as God for Christ's sake has forgiven you.

verses.text: Be therefore followers of God, as dear children.
And walk in love, as Christ also has loved us. Christ has given Himself for us as an offering and a sacrifice to God. It was a sweetsmelling savour (smell).

But fornication (sexual sin), and all uncleanness (impure living), or covetousness (wanting what belongs to others): Let it not once be named among you. This is as becomes (is right for) saints (holy people).
Neither let there be filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting (dirty joking), which are not convenient (fitting). But rather let there be giving of thanks.

For this you know. No whoremonger (person who does sexual sin) has any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God. Neither does an unclean person, nor a covetous (greedy) person, who is an idolater (one who worships idols).
Let no one deceive (fool) you with vain (empty) words. Because of these things the wrath (anger) of God comes on the children of disobedience (people who disobey God).
Do not be therefore partakers (sharers) with them.
For you were sometimes (once) darkness, but now you are light in the Lord. Walk as children of light.
For the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness (being right with God) and truth.
Prove (test and find out) what is acceptable to the Lord.
And have no fellowship (sharing) with the unfruitful works of darkness. Rather reprove (show the wrong of) them.
It is a shame even to speak of those things. They are done by them in secret.
But all things that are reproved (shown to be wrong) are made manifest (plain to see) by the light. Whatever makes manifest (plain to see) is light.
Therefore God says: Awake, you who sleep, and arise from the dead. And Christ will give you light.
See then that you walk circumspectly (carefully). Do not walk as fools, but as wise.
Redeem (buy back) the time, because the days are evil.
Therefore do not be unwise, but understanding what the will of the Lord is.
And do not be drunk with wine, in which is excess (wild living). But be filled with the Spirit.
Speak to yourselves in psalms and hymns and spiritual songs. Sing and make melody in your heart to the Lord.
Give thanks always for all things to God and the Father. Do it in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.
Submit yourselves one to another in the fear of God.
Wives, submit yourselves to your own husbands, as to the Lord.
For the husband is the head of the wife. Even so Christ is the head of the church. And Christ is the Saviour of the body.
Therefore as the church is subject to Christ, so let the wives be subject. Let them be subject to their own husbands in everything.
Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the church. Christ gave Himself for the church.
Christ did this that He might sanctify (make holy) and cleanse the church. He cleanses it with the washing of water by the word.
Christ did this so that He might present it to Himself a glorious church. It would not have spot, or wrinkle, or any such thing. It should be holy and without blemish (fault).
So men ought to love their wives as their own bodies. The man who loves his wife loves himself.
For no man ever yet hated his own flesh (body). Every man nourishes (feeds) and cherishes (cares for) it, even as the Lord does the church.
For we are members of His body, of His flesh, and of His bones.
For this cause a man will leave his father and mother. The man will be joined to his wife. And the 2 of them will be one flesh (one body).
This is a great mystery (secret). But I speak concerning Christ and the church.
Nevertheless let every one of you in particular so love his wife even as himself. And let the wife see that she reverence (respect) her husband.

verses.text: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.
Honour your father and mother. This is the first commandment with promise.
Then it may be well with you. And you may live long on the earth.
And, you fathers, do not provoke your children to wrath (anger). Bring them up in the nurture (training) and admonition (warning and teaching) of the Lord.
Servants, be obedient to those who are your masters according to the flesh (here on earth). Obey with fear and trembling, in singleness (honesty) of your heart, as to Christ.
Do not obey with eyeservice (working only when watched), as menpleasers (people pleasers). Obey as the servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart.
With good will do service, as to the Lord, and not to people.
Know that whatever good thing anyone does, they will receive the same from the Lord. This is true whether they are bond (slave) or free.
And, you masters, do the same things to them. Forbear (hold back from) threatening. Know that your Master also is in heaven. And there is no respect of persons (favoring anyone) with Him.
Finally, my brothers, be strong in the Lord, and in the power of His might.
Put on the whole armour of God. Then you may be able to stand against the wiles (tricks) of the devil.

For we wrestle not against flesh and blood (people). We wrestle against principalities (rulers), and against powers. We wrestle against the rulers of the darkness of this world. We wrestle against spiritual wickedness in high places.
Therefore take to you the whole armour of God. Then you may be able to withstand (stand against) in the evil day. And having done all, you may stand.
Stand therefore, having your loins (waist) girt about (tied) with truth. Have on the breastplate (chest armor) of righteousness (being right with God).
Have your feet shod (wearing shoes) with the preparation of the gospel (good news) of peace.
Above all, take the shield of faith. With it you will be able to quench (put out) all the fiery darts (burning arrows) of the wicked.
And take the helmet of salvation. Take the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God.

Pray always with all prayer and supplication (asking) in the Spirit. Watch thereunto (stay alert for this) with all perseverance (never giving up). Make supplication (asking) for all saints (holy people).
And pray for me, that utterance (words) may be given to me. Then I may open my mouth boldly, to make known the mystery (secret) of the gospel (good news).
For the gospel (good news) I am an ambassador (messenger) in bonds (chains). Pray that in it I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.
Tychicus is a beloved (dearly loved) brother and faithful minister (servant) in the Lord. He will make known to you all things. Then you also may know my affairs, and how I do.
I have sent Tychicus to you for the same purpose. I want you to know our affairs. And I want Tychicus to comfort your hearts.
Peace be to the brothers, and love with faith. These come from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
Grace be with all those who love our Lord Jesus Christ in sincerity (with an honest heart). Amen.
